notes: Why? explanations rewritten in plain words: which piece was under attack, what your move missed, what the best move fixes, how the trades end, and a tip to remember.
Share now copies only the link.
Bot games: the two players get their own names.
Shared review page redone: the board fits the screen, buttons right under it, eval bar, play-through, flip, swipe on phones, link to a move, PGN and Lichess buttons.
